|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[A Trophy Sacrificed (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V5-D-atrophysacrificed-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-atrophysacrificed022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/atrophysacrificed.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Dark/large/atrophysacrificed.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). LOST: Cancel an attempt to use a weapon to target your alien. OR Cancel Sense.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Trophy Sacrificed (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 16 August 2023<ref name="img-atrophysacrificed53572eb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/atrophysacrificed.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 commit 53572eb] (16 August 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual5-Dark/large/atrophysacrificed.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
